productionIntegrityGate.deepFlagNote: §314A names a --deep mode. The tool has none, because it is DEEP BY CONSTRUCTION: it always downloads and re-hashes every object in full (mode READ_ONLY_FULL_REHASH) and has no shallow path to opt out of. syntheticProductionProof.account: s314a-synthetic-…@internal-acceptance.invalid, created through normal governed signup with the real registration agreement
syntheticProductionProof.payloads: Two valid 1x1 PNGs, DIFFERENT content, IDENTICAL byte length (69 bytes each). Equal length is the case BR-8 names when it says content length is not integrity.
syntheticProductionProof.A_initialUpload: 201. Server-recorded digest is sha256(A); downloading the object returns bytes whose sha256 IS A.
syntheticProductionProof.B_exactReplay: Same storage_object id, same digest, served bytes unchanged. storage_objects rows carrying the identifier: 1. file_upload_completed audit rows: 1 — unchanged by the replay, so there was no second material PUT and no duplicate audit side effect.
syntheticProductionProof.C_divergentReplay: 409 Conflict, reason PAYLOAD_MISMATCH. No object id returned. Evidence A REMAINS AUTHORITATIVE: the served bytes are still A and are provably not B, and the recorded digest still describes A.
syntheticProductionProof.D_operationMismatch: 409 Conflict, reason OPERATION_MISMATCH. The other inspection's object was NOT handed back.
syntheticProductionProof.E_recovery: Reconciler: PROTECTED, LIVE_MATCHED=6 (5 real + synthetic), DIGEST_MISMATCH=0, LIVE_UNBACKED=0, RECOVERY_ONLY_SUSPECT=0, UNKNOWN=0. Exactly one recovery generation was captured, for the synthetic object; none for any real customer object.
syntheticProductionProof.destructiveTestingAvoided: No race storm, no induced infrastructure failure, no forced interruption. Concurrency and interruption boundaries remain where §314 proved them — on the disposable rig.

syntheticCleanupAndBr7.resurrectionRefused: Closed on two independent mechanisms. (1) The §314 repair makes a retired row terminal: any replay of its clientRequestId is refused with EVIDENCE_RETIRED, proven on the rig at 02-AFTER §4 and 04-BR7 §3. (2) In production the deleted account cannot authenticate at all (401), so the route is unreachable to it. STATED PRECISELY: the EVIDENCE_RETIRED refusal was NOT re-exercised against production in §314A, because deleting the account revoked the session needed to attempt it and §314A authorises only one synthetic account. The production statement is the erasure and its authority, not a second live replay attempt.
